name: Hatsudai
tagline: Shinjuku in 11 minutes and Shibuya in 21 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Shibuya City, served by Keio New Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 32 minutes to Otemachi, 11 minutes to Shinjuku, 21 minutes to Shibuya and 40 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 41.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 11.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 41.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 30.3 m to 41.5 m, a difference of 11.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: 成城石井 オペラシティ店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 6 clinics and 6 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 温光会内藤病院, about 3 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 東洋病院, about 10 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Keio New Line.
congestion: The ministry's congestion survey does not publish figures for Keio New Line. It covers the major commuter stretches, and this line is not among them.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥290,000 to ¥300,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Sangubashi; for lower rent, Hatsudai.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Hatsudai. Hatsudai adds the Keio New Line; Sangubashi adds the Odakyu Odawara Line. Sangubashi is at least 8 minutes quicker to Toranomon and Tokyo. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥13,000 more at Sangubashi.

neighbours.lead: Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome is ahead on how close the centre is and quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Hatsudai. Hatsudai adds the Keio New Line; Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome adds the Toei Oedo Line. Nishi-Shinjuku-Gochome is at least 13 minutes quicker to Toranomon and Roppongi. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

goodFor: People who want a large park within walking distance
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: The 首都高速4号新宿線 viaduct runs right beside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
甲州街道 (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Keio New Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the low side for the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
